mapper.select: /* 대국민포털_전문가내업무관리 전문가회원 정보 조회 (ExprtTaskMapper.selectExprtInfo) */ SELECT ei.encpt_exprt_flnm , ei.aprv_stts_cd AS exprt_aprv_stts_code , (SELECT com_dtl_cd_nm FROM kids_own.TB_CA_C_DTL_CODE WHERE com_group_cd = 'PP000004' AND com_dtl_cd = ei.aprv_stts_cd) AS exprt_aprv_stts_label , ei.rjct_rsn , ei.exprt_no , ei.mbr_no , ii.inst_nm , ii.brno , (SELECT date_trunc('second', MAX(reg_dt)) FROM kids_own.tb_ca_l_sesn_log_info_mng WHERE srvc_user_id = ei.rgtr_id) AS last_lgn_dt FROM kids_own.TB_PP_M_EXPRT_INFO ei , kids_own.TB_PP_M_INST ii WHERE ei.exprt_no = (SELECT exprt_no FROM kids_own.TB_PP_M_EXPRT_INFO WHERE mbr_no = #{mbrNo} ORDER BY reg_dt DESC LIMIT 1) AND ii.del_yn = 'N' AND ei.brno = ii.brno

/* 대국민포털_전문가내업무관리 전문가회원 업무 목록 조회 (ExprtTaskMapper.selectExprtTasks) */ SELECT it.task_se_cd AS value , (SELECT com_dtl_cd_nm FROM kids_own.TB_CA_C_DTL_CODE WHERE com_group_cd = 'PP000013' AND com_dtl_cd = it.task_se_cd) AS label , et.aprv_stts_cd AS task_aprv_stts_code , (SELECT com_dtl_cd_nm FROM kids_own.TB_CA_C_DTL_CODE WHERE com_group_cd = 'PP000004' AND com_dtl_cd = et.aprv_stts_cd) AS task_aprv_stts_label , et.rjct_rsn , et.exprt_task_sn , it.bzmn_task_mng_no FROM kids_own.TB_PP_M_INST_TASK it LEFT OUTER JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_EXPRT_TASK et ON it.bzmn_task_mng_no = et.bzmn_task_mng_no AND et.exprt_no = #{exprtNo} WHERE it.brno = #{brno} AND it.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.delete: /* 대국민포털_전문가내업무관리 전문가회원 권한 전체 삭제 (ExprtTaskMapper.deleteExprtAuth) */ DELETE FROM kids_own.TB_PP_M_EXPRT_AUTHRT WHERE mbr_no = (SELECT MAX(mbr_no) FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_info WHERE exprt_no = #{exprtNo})
mapper.select: /* 대국민포털_전문가내업무관리 업무시스템에 해당하는 메뉴 목록 조회 (ExprtTaskMapper.selectExprtMenus) */ WITH RECURSIVE /* [1] 로그인 사용자 권한에 매핑된 메뉴 목록 */ auth_menu AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_sn, m.up_menu_sn FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_authrt ea JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_authrt_menu am ON ea.authrt_cd = am.authrt_cd JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_menu m ON am.menu_sn = m.menu_sn WHERE ea.mbr_no = #{mbrNo} AND ea.exprt_task_sn > 0 AND m.use_yn = 'Y' ), /* [2] auth_menu 내부에서 자식이 없는(leaf) 메뉴만 추출 */ leaf_auth_menu AS ( SELECT am.menu_sn, am.up_menu_sn FROM auth_menu am WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_menu c WHERE c.up_menu_sn = am.menu_sn ) ), /* [3] 최종 트리 대상 집합: auth_menu + (leaf 메뉴의 직계 부모 1단계) */ menu_scope AS ( SELECT am.menu_sn, am.up_menu_sn FROM auth_menu am UNION SELECT p.menu_sn, p.up_menu_sn FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_menu p JOIN leaf_auth_menu lm ON lm.up_menu_sn = p.menu_sn WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ), /* [4] menu_scope 집합을 루트부터 하향으로 펼쳐 트리 메타(depth/path/root) 생성 */ menu_tree AS ( SELECT m.menu_sn, NULL::numeric AS up_menu_sn, 1 AS dep_level, m.menu_sn AS root_sn, m.menu_sn::text AS path FROM menu_scope m LEFT JOIN menu_scope p ON m.up_menu_sn = p.menu_sn WHERE m.up_menu_sn IS NULL OR p.menu_sn IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.menu_sn, c.up_menu_sn, p.dep_level + 1 AS dep_level, p.root_sn, p.path || ' > ' || c.menu_sn::text AS path FROM menu_scope c JOIN menu_tree p ON c.up_menu_sn = p.menu_sn ) SELECT mt.menu_sn, mt.up_menu_sn, mt.dep_level, mt.root_sn, mt.path, m.menu_nm, m.task_se_cd, /* [5] 업무구분 코드명을 코드테이블에서 조회 */ ( SELECT com_dtl_cd_nm FROM kids_own.tb_ca_c_dtl_code WHERE com_group_cd = 'PP000012' AND com_dtl_cd = m.task_se_cd AND com_dtl_cd != 'PP' ) AS task_se_nm, m.menu_seq, m.lang_se_cd, d.menu_url_addr, d.menu_npag_nm, d.prvc_incl_yn, d.dgstfn_exmn_yn, d.menu_expsr_yn, d.dept_info_expsr_yn, d.pic_info_expsr_yn, d.mobl_aplcn_yn, d.lgn_yn, d.encpt_pic_telno, d.menu_kogl_cprgt_type_cd, d.menu_pic_id, COALESCE(emp.emp_nm, '') AS menu_pic_flnm, emp.dept_no AS menu_tkcg_dept_no, COALESCE(emp.dept_nm, '') AS menu_tkcg_dept_nm FROM menu_tree mt JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_menu m ON m.menu_sn = mt.menu_sn LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_d_menu d ON d.menu_sn = mt.menu_sn /* [6] 메뉴 담당자(직원+부서) 조회용 파생 테이블 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.emp_no, a.emp_nm, a.dept_no, b.dept_nm FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info a JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_dept_info b ON a.dept_no = b.dept_no ) emp ON d.menu_pic_id = emp.emp_no ORDER BY m.task_se_cd, m.menu_seq, mt.menu_sn
